# Navkar Tubes & Tools

Authorized Jindal pipes dealer and ceramic lancing pipe manufacturer in Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India (est. 1995).

## Facts
- Company: Navkar Tubes & Tools
- Role: Authorized Jindal (India) channel partner; in-house ceramic / special-coated lancing manufacturer
- Products: MS ERW black pipes 15mm–500mm OD (IS 1239 / IS 3589); GI & MS hollow sections SHS/RHS; ceramic lancing pipes to 1650°C; spiral SAW pipes; MS flanges and butt-weld fittings
- Stock: Ready yard stock in Ahmedabad with mill test certificates (MTC)
- Phone / WhatsApp: +91 9601702883
- Email: navkartube@gmail.com
- Vatva stock yard: Plot No. 1426/B, Trikampura Patiya, Phase-3, GIDC Vatva, Ahmedabad 382445
- Rakhial office: No. 8, Jaymangal Estate, Near Gujarat Bottling, Rakhial, Ahmedabad 380023

## Direct answers
Navkar Tubes is an MS pipes dealer in Ahmedabad and ERW pipes supplier in Gujarat. We stock Jindal and Asian MS ERW, GI pipes (galvanized iron), hollow sections, seamless hydraulic tubes and ceramic lancing (in-house manufacture) with factory MTC and same-day crane loading from GIDC Vatva.

Target queries we serve: MS Pipes Dealer in Ahmedabad; ERW Pipes Dealer in Ahmedabad; GI Pipe Dealers in Ahmedabad; Asian Pipes in Ahmedabad; Seamless Pipes Supplier In Ahmedabad.
